title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior spreads and persists in a population under peer influence, policy mandates, media messaging, and supply constraints.

interactions.name: peer_influence
interactions.description: Individuals observe neighbors' mask use and update their adoption decision based on social influence and compliance thresholds.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: Mandates and enforcement at locations affect individuals' mask-wearing and adoption persistence.

interactions.name: information_diffusion
interactions.description: Authorities and media broadcast messages that alter perceived benefits/costs and risk perception.

interactions.name: market_transaction
interactions.description: Individuals buy masks subject to retailer inventory and price.

interactions.name: location_observation
interactions.description: Individuals observe mask prevalence at locations which informs their beliefs and perceived norms.

interactions.name: policy_to_location_rules
interactions.description: Policy makers set or lift entry requirements at locations that condition access on mask use.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Fraction of the population wearing masks at each time step.

metrics.name: peak_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Maximum adoption level achieved during the simulation.

metrics.name: time_to_50_percent_adoption
metrics.description: Number of days until adoption reaches 50% of the population.

metrics.name: sustained_adoption_after_mandate_end
metrics.description: Average adoption level in a window after mandates are lifted.

metrics.name: adoption_inequality_index
metrics.description: Disparity in adoption across demographic groups (e.g., by income or political orientation).

metrics.name: adoption_clustering
metrics.description: Clustering coefficient or assortativity of adopters within the social network.

metrics.name: policy_effect_size
metrics.description: Difference in adoption between mandate and non-mandate periods, controlling for other factors.

metrics.name: influence_attribution
metrics.description: Share of adoption events attributable to peer influence, mandates, information campaigns, and market access.

metrics.name: mask_shortage_days
metrics.description: Number of days with retailer stockouts preventing purchases.

metrics.name: enforcement_actions_per_day
metrics.description: Average number of enforcement events (warnings/fines) per day.

validation_criteria.name: adoption_convergence
validation_criteria.description: Adoption rate change < 1 percentage point over the last 7 days indicates steady state.

validation_criteria.name: supply_sanity_check
validation_criteria.description: Total new adopters cannot exceed cumulative available masks over time.

validation_criteria.name: policy_monotonicity
validation_criteria.description: Increasing mandate_effect_strength should not decrease adoption, holding other parameters constant.

validation_criteria.name: no_policy_baseline_stability
validation_criteria.description: With mandate_effect_strength=0 and social_influence_strength=0, adoption remains near the initial_adoption_rate.

validation_criteria.name: optional_calibration_RMSE
validation_criteria.description: If a target adoption curve is provided, RMSE between simulated and target adoption < specified threshold.
